mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MEMBER ORDER BY MNO DESC
mapper.insert: SELECT MEMBER_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO MEMBER(MNO,MEMAIL,MPASSWD,MNAME,MGENDER,MAGE,MADDR,MTEL,MACCOUNT,MAUTH,MSTATUS,MDATE) VALUES(#{mno},#{memail},#{mpasswd},#{mname},#{mgender},#{mage},#{maddr},#{mtel},#{maccount},'NORMAL','ACTIVE',SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET MAUTH = 'NORMAL' WHERE MAUTH = 'SUBSCRIBER' AND MNO NOT IN ( SELECT MNO FROM MEMBER_PASSES WHERE MPSTATUS = 'ACTIVE' )
